_comment: Inchworm params. Load: --params path. Save: --save_params path. Pressure range = gait_pressure_min/max (loader derives baseline/amplitude).
_angle_comment: Change soft robot angles (lift base higher = smaller joint angle): (1) CLI: --gait_baseline F --gait_amplitude F (e.g. 1.7 and 0.5, or 2.0/0.55 for higher); (2) Here: raise gait_baseline or gait_pressure_max, or lower total_mass / chamber_stiffness_scale for ch1,ch3. Belly sag: raise chamber_stiffness_scale for ch0,ch2.
_lift_comment: Smaller joint angles when base is parallel (both legs up): increase lift by raising gait_pressure_max (or --gait_baseline on CLI), lowering total_mass, softening material (k_mu/k_lambda) or active chambers (lower chamber_stiffness_scale for ch1,ch3). Center sagging when both legs up: raise chamber_stiffness_scale for backbone ch0,ch2 (belly).
_chamber_comment: chamber_active_inflation: 1=active 0=inactive [ch0,ch1,ch2,ch3]. chamber_stiffness_scale: per-chamber multiplier on k_mu/k_lambda; higher = stiffer (backbone ch0,ch2 = belly/center, raise to prevent middle sagging when both legs up); lower for ch1,ch3 = more lift.
_paper_comment: Paper (Gamus et al., arXiv:1911.05227). Link length l = L/(2+beta). Joints at 1/(2+beta) and (1+beta)/(2+beta) along crawl axis. Fig.4: gamma=90°, A=π/6 → joint angles 60–120°. paper_beta = paper's dimensionless shape parameter (not derived from chamber count); example uses 2.0.
_contact_constraint_comment: Same-height constraint (paper Eq. 2). 0 = allow one foot to lift (legs alternate in Fig. 6 improved). >0 = both feet stay in contact.
